read.thesis: Postpaid account growth and ARPA raised, with FY26 core EBITDA $37.35–37.45B and FCF $18.7–18.8B; but Q4 churn seasonality and Q3 inventory slippage flag near-term noise, and capex held at ~$10B.

capex.quote: Our expectation for full year 2026 cash CapEx remains unchanged at approximately $10 billion.

triggers.label: Postpaid ARPA growth 2.5–3% → ~3.5%
triggers.quote: we now expect full year postpaid ARPA growth of approximately 3.5%, up from our previous expectation of 2.5% to 3%

triggers.label: Core EBITDA up $100M at midpoint
triggers.quote: Core adjusted EBITDA is now expected to be between $37.35 billion and $37.45 billion for the full year, up $100 million at the midpoint

triggers.label: Q3 inventory constraints shift EBITDA to Q4
triggers.quote: there's frankly also been some Q3 inventory constraints as well that have shifted some things from Q3 into Q4

triggers.label: Q4 churn seasonally higher
triggers.quote: Q4 tends to be a higher churn quarter than Q3 because of the holiday season

guidance.quote: we now expect approximately 1 million account net additions for the year once again
we now expect full year service revenues of approximately $76.8 billion, representing 8% growth
we now expect full year postpaid ARPA growth of approximately 3.5%, up from our previous expectation of 2.5% to 3%
Core adjusted EBITDA is now expected to be between $37.35 billion and $37.45 billion for the full year
we now expect adjusted free cash flow to be between $18.7 billion and $18.8 billion
Our expectation for full year 2026 cash CapEx remains unchanged at approximately $10 billion.

guidance.metric: Q4 postpaid organic service revenue growth
guidance.quote: Q4 postpaid organic service revenue growth now expected to be approximately 7% year-over-year
Effective Tax Rate Guidance -- 24% to 25%, decreased from the prior guidance of 25% to 26%.

red_flags.label: Q4 churn seasonality and rate-plan churn drag
red_flags.quote: we do anticipate a little bit of impact in Q4

red_flags.label: Management avoids postpaid phone churn disclosure
red_flags.quote: we didn't give a postpaid phone churn number

evasions.quote: we didn't give a postpaid phone churn number
we're going to update 2027 guidance when we get to the Q4 call
